segments.an8.69:1.3: Khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā.
segments.an8.69:1.4: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā.
segments.an8.69:1.5: Tatrapi mayā sannisinnapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpannapubbā.
segments.an8.69:1.6: Tattha yādisako tesaṃ vaṇṇo hoti tādisako mayhaṃ vaṇṇo hoti, yādisako tesaṃ saro hoti tādisako mayhaṃ saro hoti.
segments.an8.69:1.7: Dhammiyā ca kathāya sandassemi samādapemi samuttejemi sampahaṃsemi.
segments.an8.69:1.9: ‘ko nu kho ayaṃ bhāsati devo vā manusso vā’ti.
segments.an8.69:1.10: Dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā antaradhāyāmi.
segments.an8.69:1.12: ‘ko nu kho ayaṃ antarahito devo vā manusso vā’”ti.

lines: Yādisako tesaṃ vaṇṇoti te odātāpi honti kāḷāpi maṅguracchavīpi, satthā suvaṇṇavaṇṇo.
Na pana bhagavā milakkhasadiso hoti, nāpi āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalo, buddhaveseneva nisīdati.
Yādisako tesaṃ saroti te chinnassarāpi honti gaggassarāpi kākassarāpi, satthā brahmassarova.
Sacepi hi satthā rājāsane nisinno katheti,“ajja rājā madhurena kathetī”ti nesaṃ hoti.
Kathetvā pakkante pana bhagavati puna rājānaṃ āgataṃ disvā “ko nu kho ayan”ti vīmaṃsā uppajjati.
Tattha ko nu kho ayanti “imasmiṃ ṭhāne idāneva māgadhabhāsāya sīhaḷabhāsāya madhurena ākārena kathento ko nu kho ayaṃ antarahito, kiṃ devo udāhu manusso”ti evaṃ vīmaṃsantāpi na jānantīti attho.
Evaṃ sutopi hi dhammo anāgate paccayo hotīti anāgataṃ paṭicca deseti.
Anekasataṃ brāhmaṇaparisantiādinaṃ soṇadaṇḍasamāgamādivasena ceva aññacakkavāḷavasena ca sambhavo veditabbo.
Navame (dī. ni. ṭī.2.172) samāgantabbato, samāgacchatīti vā samāgamo, parisā.
Ādito tehi saddhiṃ satthu bhāsanaṃ ālāpo, kathanappaṭikathanaṃ sallāpo.
Saṇṭhānaṃ paṭicca kathitaṃ saṇṭhānapariyāyattā vaṇṇa-saddassa “mahantaṃ hatthirājavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā”tiādīsu (saṃ. ni.1.138) viya.
Tesanti padaṃ ubhayapadāpekkhaṃ “tesampi lakkhaṇasaṇṭhānaṃ viya satthu sarīrasaṇṭhānaṃ tesaṃ kevalaṃ paññāyati evā”ti.
Kimatthaṃ … pe … desetīti idaṃ nanu attānaṃ jānāpetvā dhamme kathite tesaṃ sātisayo pasādo hotīti iminā adhippāyena vuttaṃ?
Yesaṃ attānaṃ ajānāpetvāva dhamme kathite pasādo hoti, na jānāpetvā, tādise sandhāya satthā tathā karoti.
Evaṃ sutopīti evaṃ aviññātadesako aviññātāgamanopi suto dhammo attano dhammasudhammatāyeva anāgate paccayo hoti suṇantassa.
